name: HAProxy
description: Protects against destructive HAProxy load balancer operations like stopping \ the service or disabling backends via runtime API.

destructive_patterns.name: haproxy-soft-stop
destructive_patterns.description: haproxy -sf sends a soft stop signal, terminating the load balancer gracefully.

destructive_patterns.name: haproxy-hard-stop
destructive_patterns.description: haproxy -st sends a hard stop signal, immediately terminating the load balancer.

destructive_patterns.name: haproxy-systemctl-stop
destructive_patterns.description: systemctl stop haproxy stops the HAProxy service.

destructive_patterns.name: haproxy-service-stop
destructive_patterns.description: service haproxy stop stops the HAProxy service.

destructive_patterns.name: haproxy-socat-disable-server
destructive_patterns.description: Disabling a server via HAProxy runtime API removes it from the load balancer pool.

destructive_patterns.name: haproxy-socat-shutdown-sessions
destructive_patterns.description: Shutting down sessions via HAProxy runtime API terminates active connections.

destructive_patterns.name: haproxy-socat-disable-frontend
destructive_patterns.description: Disabling a frontend via HAProxy runtime API stops accepting new connections.

destructive_patterns.name: haproxy-socat-shutdown-frontend
destructive_patterns.description: Shutting down a frontend via HAProxy runtime API terminates it immediately.

destructive_patterns.name: haproxy-config-delete
destructive_patterns.description: Removing files from /etc/haproxy deletes HAProxy configuration.
